note: Wikimedia Commons, “Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 03281 Стефан.png”; artist as recorded there: Unknown author — fetched 14 October 2026 at 619px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Two independent pieces of evidence, which is why this one rather than the colour frescoes beside it. First, Commons itself files this plate in `Category:Stephen the Younger` — the English name for Stephen the New of Mount Saint Auxentius, which is this folder: display name «Stephen the New», Russian form «Стефан Новый, Константинопольский», the venerable-martyr confessor of the iconoclast persecution. Second, the Menaion Reader plate code «03281» is church-month 03 = November, day 28, and 28 November is this folder's feast in all four calendars. 619x1654. The day and the category agree, so the bare title «Стефан» is not doing the work alone. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
